_note: Generated from 2-framework/framework-v3/padel-iq-skills.csv by npm run import-framework. name = English (or the padel word), es = Spanish, aka = other words (search).

items.name: Serve
items.what: Bounce the ball and serve at or below waist height into the diagonal service box, following the serving rules.
items.when: To start the point. Depth means deeper inside the service box.

items.name: Forehand volley
items.what: A forehand hit before the ball bounces, usually at the net.
items.when: When you're at the net and the ball comes to you in the air.

items.name: Backhand volley
items.what: A backhand hit before the ball bounces, usually at the net.
items.when: When you're at the net and the ball comes to you in the air.

items.name: Block volley
items.what: A short, firm volley with almost no swing that uses the ball's own pace.
items.when: Against fast balls at the net, or to get the ball low at their feet.

items.name: Drop volley
items.what: A soft volley that drops just over the net.
items.when: When both opponents are deep at the back.

items.name: Basic overhead
items.what: Hitting a high ball above your head with control rather than power.
items.when: When a lob is short enough to reach without running back.

items.name: Bandeja
items.what: A controlled sliced overhead used to manage a lob and keep or regain a useful net position.
items.when: On a reachable lob when a controlled overhead is safer than a smash.

items.name: Víbora
items.what: An attacking overhead with sidespin, played from a suitable lob with balance.
items.when: Against medium lobs when you want to put more pressure on.

items.name: Smash
items.what: A full, hard overhead hit downwards.
items.when: When a lob is short and you have time to set up.

items.name: Hook
items.what: A quick overhead hit in front of the body from the side, near the net, without turning fully sideways.
items.when: When a ball comes high and fast to you at the net with no time to set up.

items.name: Topspin smash
items.what: A smash with heavy topspin that kicks up off the back glass.
items.when: To push opponents back or force a weak reply.

items.name: Smash out the side (x3)
items.what: A smash that bounces in court and exits above the side enclosure. It may remain returnable where outside play is authorised.
items.when: Against a short lob in the middle of the court when you can finish the point.

items.name: Smash out the back (x4)
items.what: A smash that bounces in court and exits above the end enclosure.
items.when: Very short high balls close to the net.

items.name: Bajada
items.what: An attacking shot hit after the ball has come off the back glass and risen high.
items.when: When a deep lob or smash rebounds high off the back wall.

items.name: Drop shot
items.what: A soft shot that lands just over the net and dies.
items.when: When opponents are deep or out of position.

items.name: Second serve
items.what: A dependable legal serve after the first serve misses.
items.when: After a first-serve fault.

items.name: Return of serve
items.what: Getting the serve back into play.
items.when: Every point you receive. Low and to the middle is the safe default.

items.name: Forehand
items.what: A forehand shot after the bounce, before any wall rebound.
items.when: Most balls at the back. At first, just get it back over the net.

items.name: Backhand
items.what: A backhand shot after the bounce, before any wall rebound.
items.when: Most balls at the back. At first, just get it back over the net.

items.name: Defensive lob
items.what: A high, deep ball over the net players.
items.when: To push opponents back and win the net back.

items.name: Back glass return
items.what: Letting the ball hit the back wall, then playing it as it comes off.
items.when: When a ball is going to reach the back glass.

items.name: Side glass return
items.what: Playing a ball that has bounced and come off the side wall.
items.when: When a ball goes wide into the side glass.

items.name: Double glass
items.what: Playing a ball that hits two walls, back then side or side then back.
items.when: Balls into the back corners.

items.name: Back wall rescue
items.what: Hitting the ball into your own back wall so it goes over the net.
items.when: An emergency shot when you can't hit the ball forwards.

items.name: Defending a smash
items.what: Read and return reachable smash rebounds and recognise when the point has ended.
items.when: When a smash remains live and safely reachable inside the court.

items.name: Chiquita
items.what: A soft, low ball from the back that lands at the net players' feet.
items.when: To make a net player volley up. Advance only if the reply gives you time.

items.name: Attacking lob
items.what: A lower, faster lob that gets behind opponents quickly.
items.when: When opponents are very close to the net.

items.name: Passing shot
items.what: A low, fast shot past a net player, down the line or through the middle.
items.when: When there's a gap, or a net player is out of position.

items.name: Half volley
items.what: Hitting the ball just after it bounces, close to your feet.
items.when: When you're caught between the back and the net.

items.name: Between the legs
items.what: Hitting a ball between your legs while running away from the net.
items.when: Emergency only, after a lob gets over you.

items.name: Behind the back
items.what: Hitting the ball behind your body when there's no time to turn.
items.when: Emergency only.

items.name: Playing outside the court
items.what: Leave through an access to return a live ball only on a court where outside play is authorised and safely possible.
items.when: For a playable side or door exit where outside play is authorised; never after an exit over the back enclosure.

items.name: Fence rebound
items.what: Return a live rally ball after its floor bounce and an irregular fence rebound.
items.when: During a rally when the ball bounces and reaches the fence.

items.name: Knowing where to stand
items.what: Where to be on court: back or net, left or right, and who covers what.
items.when: All the time. The first thing new players learn.

items.name: Ready position and split step
items.es: Posición de espera y split step
items.what: Prepare the racket and use a small timed split step or loading action around the opponent's contact.
items.when: Before every shot you receive.

items.name: Taking and holding the net
items.what: Moving up to the net together and staying there.
items.when: After a good lob, chiquita or return.

items.name: Recovery
items.what: Getting back into position after each shot.
items.when: After every shot, especially after being pulled wide.

items.name: Moving as a pair
items.what: Moving forwards, back and sideways together with your partner.
items.when: All the time. Gaps between partners lose points.

items.name: Shot choice
items.what: Picking the right shot for the situation.
items.when: Every shot. Placement over power.

items.name: Talking to your partner
items.what: Calls like mine, yours, leave, and agreeing a plan.
items.when: During points and between them.

items.name: Building points
items.what: Using several shots to set up a winner, rather than forcing one.
items.when: Once rallies are steady.

items.name: The middle ball
items.what: Decide who takes a shared ball and cover the space left by the hitter.
items.when: Middle balls, central lobs and changes of sides.

items.name: Rules and scoring
items.what: Use the agreed scoring format and recognise common legal and illegal play.
items.when: Before and during a match.

items.name: Composure
items.what: Prepare deliberately for the next point, including at tight scores.
items.when: Before the next point, especially when the score feels important.

items.name: Bouncing back
items.what: Refocus after a mistake and use it to choose a useful next action.
items.when: After a bad point or a run of errors.

items.name: Focus
items.what: Return attention to the ball, score and next-point preparation when it drifts.
items.when: Through long rallies and long matches.
